heading.en: How many digits can we trust?

hook.en: A ruler marked in millimetres cannot tell you a length of 12.3456 cm. The digits we report must show how precise the measurement really is.
hook.kn: ಮಿಲಿಮೀಟರ್ ಗುರುತಿನ ಅಳತೆಪಟ್ಟಿ 12.3456 cm ಉದ್ದವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಲಾರದು. ನಾವು ಬರೆಯುವ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು ಅಳತೆಯ ನಿಜವಾದ ನಿಖರತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು.

narration.en: A ruler marked in millimetres cannot tell you a length of 12.3456 cm. The digits we report must show how precise the measurement really is.
narration.kn: ಮಿಲಿಮೀಟರ್ ಗುರುತಿನ ಅಳತೆಪಟ್ಟಿ 12.3456 cm ಉದ್ದವನ್ನು ಹೇಳಲಾರದು. ನಾವು ಬರೆಯುವ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು ಅಳತೆಯ ನಿಜವಾದ ನಿಖರತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು.

body.en: Significant figures are the reliable digits plus the first uncertain digit. All non-zero digits count. Zeros between non-zero digits count. Leading zeros, as in 0.0045, never count. Trailing zeros after a decimal point do count, so 2.500 has four. Scientific notation removes all doubt: $4.700 \times 10^{3}$ has four significant figures.
body.kn: ಸಾರ್ಥಕ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು ಎಂದರೆ ನಂಬಲರ್ಹ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮೊದಲ ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಅಂಕಿ. ಶೂನ್ಯವಲ್ಲದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಅಂಕಿಗಳು ಸಾರ್ಥಕ. ಎರಡು ಶೂನ್ಯವಲ್ಲದ ಅಂಕಿಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸೊನ್ನೆಗಳು ಸಾರ್ಥಕ. ಎಡಭಾಗದ ಸೊನ್ನೆಗಳು ಸಾರ್ಥಕವಲ್ಲ. ದಶಮಾಂಶದ ನಂತರದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಸೊನ್ನೆಗಳು ಸಾರ್ಥಕ.

points.en: Changing units does not change them: 2.308 cm = 0.02308 m (4 s.f.)

say.en: Count the significant figures in each number using the rules.
In multiplication and division, the answer keeps as few significant figures as the least precise number.
In addition and subtraction, keep as few decimal places as the least precise number.
Rounding: drop a digit above 5 by raising, below 5 by leaving. For exactly 5, make the kept digit even.

narration.en: On the board: Counting and using significant figures.

body.en: In multiplication or division, keep as many significant figures as the least precise number has. In addition or subtraction, keep as many decimal places as the number with the fewest decimal places. When rounding, raise the last kept digit if the dropped digit is more than 5, leave it if less than 5, and if it is exactly 5, make the last kept digit even.
body.kn: ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾಗಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಾರ್ಥಕ ಅಂಕಿಗಳಿರುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾರ್ಥಕ ಅಂಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ. ಸಂಕಲನ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯವಕಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ದಶಮಾಂಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಿರುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ದಶಮಾಂಶ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ.

problem.en: A body has mass 4.237 g and volume 2.51 cm³. Find its density to the correct number of significant figures.

steps.en: The volume has 3 significant figures, the fewest, so keep 3.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A body has mass 4.237 g and volume 2.51 cm³. Find its density to the correct number of significant figures.

problem.en: Add 436.32 g, 227.2 g and 0.301 g and report the result correctly.

steps.en: 227.2 g has only one decimal place, the fewest.
Round to one decimal place: 663.8 g.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Add 436.32 g, 227.2 g and 0.301 g and report the result correctly.

body.en: Write the number as a × 10ᵇ with 1 ≤ a < 10. Every digit in a is significant: 0.004700 = 4.700 × 10⁻³, so it has 4 significant figures.

narration.en: Scientific notation settles the zeros. Write the number as a × 10ᵇ with 1 ≤ a < 10. Every digit in a is significant: 0.004700 = 4.700 × 10⁻³, so it has 4 significant figures.

mnemonic.en: Leading zeros lie; trailing zeros after the point tell.

narration.en: Class quiz. I will call out roll numbers; the student whose number is called answers on the board.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಾನು ಹಾಜರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತೇನೆ; ಕರೆದ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಲಿ.

points.en: Leading zeros never count; trailing zeros after a decimal point do.
